wave: Wave A — Evidence Bundle Structure & Hash Reference
objective: Align the existing MCC Evidence Bundle implementation (src/mcc_evidence/) with the exact normative structural and integrity requirements of MCC-EB-001, and implement the structured Hash Reference required as a reusable integrity primitive by MCC-CM-001, reusing existing canonical serialization and digest primitives rather than creating a second Evidence Bundle subsystem.
source_baseline_commit_note: Requirement IDs, statuses, and source_line values below were re-verified against the corrected 810-requirement baseline (PR #62) at conformance/normative-v1.0/requirements.json before any production code was written.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: An Evidence Bundle has exactly one Bundle Root -- there is never more than one, and never zero.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: src/mcc_evidence exports/verifies bundles in directory and .tar.gz form with bundle-level metadata, semantically close to this section, but uses one manifest.json plus named artifact paths rather than this specification's separate Bundle Descriptor / Integrity Record / Provenance Record files.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No producer wrote a single Bundle Root containing exactly the MCC-EB-001-shaped file set.
selected_requirements.production_change: src/mcc_evidence/eb001_export.py:build_eb001_bundle writes one Bundle Root (directory or archive) per call.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: The Bundle Root contains exactly one Bundle Descriptor, one Integrity Record, one Provenance Record, and one Evidence Directory -- no fewer, no more, no duplicates.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: Same as EB-STR-001: existing bundle uses one manifest.json + named artifacts, not this specification's four-entry top-level layout.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No verifier checked for the exact four-entry Bundle Root layout or rejected duplicates/missing entries.
selected_requirements.production_change: eb001_export.py writes exactly the four entries; eb001_verify.py's root_structure check rejects any bundle missing one, duplicating one, or containing an unaccounted fifth entry.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Bundle directory structure is deterministic for equivalent certification inputs -- regenerating from the same input always produces the same structure.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: schema.py documents and excludes non-deterministic fields from equivalence comparison for the mcc-evidence/1 schema, not this specification's Bundle.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No MCC-EB-001-shaped bundle existed to be deterministic.
selected_requirements.production_change: build_eb001_bundle takes no wall-clock timestamp, random ID (bundle_id is caller-supplied or a single uuid4 computed once, not per-field), or unordered collection; two independent generations of equivalent input are byte-identical.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Directory and file naming remains stable across regeneration of an equivalent Bundle.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION conventions exist for the mcc-evidence/1 schema; no stable-naming guarantee existed for this specification's Bundle.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No fixed filename convention for this Bundle shape existed.
selected_requirements.production_change: eb001_schema.py defines fixed filename constants (bundle_descriptor.json / integrity_record.json / provenance_record.json / evidence/) never derived from wall-clock time or randomness.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: The directory form and the archive form of a Bundle are structurally equivalent.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: The mcc-evidence/1 export path supports both forms from the same manifest, an analogous but differently-shaped guarantee.
existing_implementation_reused: src/mcc_evidence/export.py's deterministic tarfile writer pattern (mtime=0, sorted member order)
selected_requirements.production_change: build_eb001_bundle derives both forms from the identical in-memory {path: bytes} set (build_bundle_files), so they are structurally equivalent by construction, not by a separate equivalence check.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: A Bundle Descriptor is present at the Bundle Root, declaring the Schema Version, a Bundle identifier, and the MCC-CP-001 specification version.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: manifest.json declares bundle_id/created_at/mcc_core_version for the mcc-evidence/1 schema, a differently-shaped descriptor.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No standalone Bundle Descriptor file existed.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: An Integrity Record is present at the Bundle Root.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: Digests are recomputed from manifest.json's per-artifact sha256 fields for the mcc-evidence/1 schema, not a standalone Integrity Record file.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No standalone Integrity Record file existed.
selected_requirements.production_change: eb001_export.py:_integrity_record writes integrity_record.json enumerating a Hash Reference per file.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: A Provenance Record is present at the Bundle Root.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: EvidenceInput (export.py) records the originating governance run and correlation id for the mcc-evidence/1 schema, a narrower and differently-scoped provenance model.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No standalone Provenance Record file existed.
selected_requirements.production_change: eb001_export.py:_provenance_record writes provenance_record.json with certification_run_id and cp001_specification_version.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Every file in the Bundle other than the Integrity Record is enumerated by it.
selected_requirements.source_section: 11.2 Integrity Record / 13.4 Digest Coverage / 11.5 Required Files Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: verify_bundle checks manifest-declared artifacts against actual files for the mcc-evidence/1 schema; not this specification's Integrity Record enumeration.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No enumeration-completeness check existed for this Bundle shape.
selected_requirements.production_change: eb001_verify.py:_integrity_checks computes the symmetric difference between actual files and enumerated paths and fails closed on either an unenumerated actual file or an enumerated-but-absent file.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Required files are never omitted regardless of certification outcome.
selected_requirements.rationale_before: No production/omission-guarantee logic existed for this Bundle shape.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: An empty certification outcome (zero Evidence Items) had no defined required-structure guarantee.
selected_requirements.production_change: build_eb001_bundle always writes all four required root entries even when evidence_items is empty (an explicit placeholder materializes the Evidence Directory so it is never silently absent); eb001_verify.py rejects a bundle any required entry was removed from.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: A Hash Reference identifies a Digest, a hash algorithm, and the content it corresponds to.
selected_requirements.source_section: 13.2 Hash Reference Structure / 13.5 Hash Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: src/mcc_core/signing.py provides the collision-resistant digest primitive; src/mcc_evidence/verify.py demonstrates it applied to binding, but not as a structured, reusable Hash Reference object.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No structured HashReference type (digest + algorithm + content_ref) existed anywhere in the repository; digests were bare strings.
selected_requirements.production_change: src/mcc_evidence/hash_reference.py:HashReference dataclass + to_dict/from_dict, fail-closed on malformed input.

selected_requirements.source_section: 13.3 Hash Algorithm Requirements / 13.5 Hash Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: The runtime signs its own authority-bearing artifact exclusively with Ed25519/sha256, with a dedicated repository-wide test confirming no symmetric-key mechanism is used, but no explicit Hash-Reference-level algorithm allowlist/rejection existed.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No mechanism rejected a non-collision-resistant algorithm at the Hash Reference level.
selected_requirements.production_change: hash_reference.py:SUPPORTED_HASH_ALGORITHMS = frozenset({"sha256"}); compute_hash_reference refuses construction, HashReference.validate()/verify_hash_reference refuse verification, for any other algorithm.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Every Evidence Bundle Reference includes at least one Hash Reference.
selected_requirements.source_section: 13.4 Hash Reference Usage / 13.5 Hash Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.exclusion_reason: DEPENDS_ON_WAVE_B. This requirement's subject is the Evidence Bundle Reference, a structured field of the Certification Manifest defined by MCC-CM-001 Section 14 (CM-EBREF-001..004, all currently GAP). No Evidence Bundle Reference object exists in this repository -- there is nothing to attach a Hash Reference to, and no honest test can exercise 'every Evidence Bundle Reference includes at least one Hash Reference' without first building the Evidence Bundle Reference itself. Building it is explicitly Wave B's scope (PR #64), not Wave A's. Promoting this requirement now would either fabricate a fictitious Evidence Bundle Reference solely to claim conformance, or claim conformance for an object that does not exist -- both excluded by this PR's constraints. HashReference itself (the reusable primitive CM-HASH-003 depends on) is fully implemented and CONFORMANT in this wave (CM-HASH-001/002/004) specifically so Wave B can attach it to the Evidence Bundle Reference without re-implementing it.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Hash References are independently recomputable and verifiable by a validator.
selected_requirements.source_section: 13.4 Hash Reference Usage / 13.5 Hash Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: src/mcc_evidence/verify.py recomputes digests independently for the mcc-evidence/1 schema; no structured, reusable Hash-Reference-level recomputation API existed.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No verify_hash_reference-equivalent function existed as a standalone, reusable, requirement-scoped primitive.
selected_requirements.production_change: hash_reference.py:verify_hash_reference recomputes the digest of supplied data and compares it to the declared value; never trusts a prior result.

additional_dependency_rationale: None. All 14 originally-listed candidate IDs were verified to exist, with materially-matching normative meaning, against the corrected 810-requirement baseline; no additional requirement ID was pulled in as an unavoidable dependency.
